h: Divine Mercy Awakens Every Soul to Complete Teshuvah

p: "And Hashem your God will circumcise your heart
It is stated in the Baal HaTurim:
to begin rising early for Selichos
to blow the shofar from Rosh Chodesh Elul,
for it is an awakening to teshuvah,
"Can a shofar be blown in a city
That is, the Ten Days of Teshuvah
is also a time of teshuvah.
And what it says, "And Hashem will circumcise," etc.,
alludes that also from the side of Hashem Yisbarach
that month is auspicious for mercy;
for then are days of favor,
when Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him, went up
and Hashem Yisbarach from His side
And this is "And Hashem your God will circumcise," etc.:
of teshuvah from the side of man,
"and you take it to your heart," etc.,
"and you return to Hashem your God," etc.,
at the end of the heavens," etc.;
even though in the preceding pasuk
"where Hashem your God has scattered you,"
and did not say "where He has driven you,"
they are no longer among the driven-away.
שֶׁיֵּשׁ עוֹד מִי שֶׁהוּא בִּכְלַל נִדָּחִים
that there is still someone among the driven-away,
a great shofar will be blown,
and those lost in the land of Ashur will come,
and those cast away in the land of Egypt."
that is, those who were assimilated among the nations
and do not know at all
that they are of the seed of Yisrael;
"and those cast away in the land of Egypt":
those who are cast away so far
like a fetus in its mother's womb;
and they need a great shofar,
to arouse even them as well;
שֶׁכָּל מִי שֶׁהוּא רַק מִזֶּרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל
for whoever is at all of the seed of Yisrael,
לֹא יִדַּח מִמֶּנּוּ נִדָּח (שְׁמוּאֵל ב יד, יד)
"no one cast away will be cast off from Him" (Shmuel II 14:14);
וְאָמַר אִם יִהְיֶה נִדַּחֲךָ בִּקְצֵה הַשָּׁמַיִם
And it says, "If your dispersed will be at the end of the heavens,"
while above, in the previous parshah,
in the parshah of the rebukes,
"from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth";
and it should have said here too:
"If your dispersed will be at the end of the earth."
אַךְ זֶה מוּסָב עַל הַנְּשָׁמָה שֶׁל הָאָדָם
But this refers to the soul of a person,
יִקְרָא אֶל הַשָּׁמַיִם מֵעָל (תְּהִלִּים נ, ד)
And it uses the expression "at the end of the heavens":
that is, they are not entirely outside the heavens,
no hold at all in holiness;
rather they are still at the end of the heavens,
שֶׁיֵּשׁ לָהֶם אֲחִיזָה בַּנְּשָׁמָה עוֹד מָה
for they still have some hold in the soul.
"From there Hashem your God will gather you,
and from there He will take you";
that is, from the side of Hashem Yisbarach;
"And I will bring it about that you walk in My statutes";
וֶהֱבִיאֲךָ ה׳ אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶל הָאָרֶץ וְגוֹמֵר
"And Hashem your God will bring you to the land," etc.;
meaning, He will bring you to holiness.
"And He will do you good and multiply you more than your fathers":
that He will make you be good;
"and multiply you more than your fathers,"
along the lines of what they said (Berachos 34b):
"In the place where baalei teshuvah stand,
וְאָמַר וּמָל ה׳ אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶת לְבָבְךָ
And it says, "And Hashem your God will circumcise your heart":
that Hashem Yisbarach from His side
will remove the evil inclination from your heart.
the meaning is as we said above,
that they will be so clarified
that the children will already be born
in holiness, without an evil inclination;
לֹא כְּמוֹ שֶׁהָיָה בִּשְׁעַת מַתַּן תּוֹרָה
not as it was at the time of Matan Torah,
when the evil inclination returned afterward.
And it says, "to love Hashem your God,"
along the lines of what is said
בְּשֵׁם הָרַבִּי רַבִּי בֶּער זֵכֶר צַדִּיק לִבְרָכָה
in the name of the Rebbe, Reb Ber, of blessed memory,
that the main effort of a person from his own side
"What does Hashem your God ask of you
and the love comes afterward by itself
from the side of Hashem Yisbarach
along the lines of what they said:
"It is the way of a man
And it says, "with all your heart":
this is as we said above (maamar 5),
נִרְאֶה דְּקָאֵי עַל ג׳ כּוֹחוֹת הַנֶּפֶשׁ
it appears to refer to the three powers of the soul,
for holiness is the essence of life,
the opposite of the three kelipos
that "remove a person from the world."
אֵת כׇּל הָאָלוֹת הָאֵלֶּה עַל אוֹיְבֶיךָ
all these curses upon your enemies";
הוּא עַל דֶּרֶךְ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (סַנְהֶדְרִין צט, א)
this is along the lines of what they said (Sanhedrin 99a):
אָמַר לֵיהּ קְרָא כְּתִיב (יְשַׁעְיָה ס, ב)
He said to him: A verse is written (Yeshayahu 60:2):
כִּי הִנֵּה הַחוֹשֶׁךְ יְכַסֶּה אֶרֶץ וְגוֹמֵר
'For behold, darkness will cover the earth,' etc.,
'but upon you Hashem will shine,' etc."
in order for the light to come to Yisrael,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּזֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג רעב, ב)
and as written in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 272b)
"Just as one must receive the Mistress
they cause the evil maidservant to remain
in darkness, in hunger, in weeping," etc.;
for "if this one is full, that one is laid waste."
And in the holy Zohar (Zohar Chadash, Balak)
מֵאֲשֶׁר יָקַרְתָּ בְעֵינַי נִכְבַּדְתָּ (יְשַׁעְיָה מג, ד)
on "Because you are precious in My eyes, you are honored" (Yeshayahu 43:4),
which it expounds about a baal teshuvah,
"and I will give man in your place":
do not read adam (man) but Edom
for then Edom must be "in your place,"
that he will inherit his own portion
and his fellow's portion in Gehinnom,
and Yisrael extract the holiness from them.
and listen to the voice of Hashem":
"And you will perform all His commandments
here it speaks of the performance of the mitzvos and their fulfillment,
For also for the fulfillment of the mitzvos
one needs the help of Hashem Yisbarach;
for the mitzvah of kind deeds
יָכוֹל כָּל אֶחָד לְקַיֵּים בְּכׇל זְמַן
anyone can fulfill at any time,
"both for the poor and for the rich"
when one does a favor for anyone at all,
he fulfills thereby the mitzvah of kind deeds.
And nevertheless we find (in the Gemara there):
that whoever comes to leap forward may leap,
'How precious is Your kindness, O God'";
for at times Hashem Yisbarach causes one to stumble,
with poor people who are not worthy
to find how to do kindness
וְזֶהוּ וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת כׇּל מִצְוֹתָיו וְגוֹמֵר
And this is "And you will perform all His commandments," etc.:
Hashem Yisbarach will help from His side

paragraphs.text: Source: Yeshayahu 43:4 — “מאשר יקרת בעיני נכבדת ואני אהבתיך ואתן אדם תחתיך ולאמים תחת נפשך” — “Because you are precious to Me, And honored, and I love you, I give people in exchange for you And nations in your stead.”

paragraphs.text: Source of the quoted words: Devarim 30:8 — “ואתה תשוב ושמעת בקול יהוה ועשית את כל מצותיו אשר אנכי מצוך היום” — “You, however, will again heed GOD and obey all the commandments that I enjoin upon you this day.”

paragraphs.text: Source of the quoted words: Devarim 6:2 — “למען תירא את יהוה אלהיך לשמר את כל חקתיו ומצותיו אשר אנכי מצוך אתה ובנך ובן בנך כל ימי חייך ולמען יארכן ימיך” — “so that you, your children, and your children’s children may revere the ETERNAL your God and follow, as long as you live, all the laws and commandments that I enjoin upon you, to the end that you may long endure.”

paragraphs.text: Source: Sukkah 49b — “… בשלשה דברים גדולה גמילות חסדים יותר מן הצדקה. צדקה — בממונו; גמילות חסדים — בין בגופו, בין בממונו. צדקה — לעניים; גמילות חסדים — בין לעניים בין לעשירים. …” (Oz Vehadar print, p. 110) — “The Sages taught that acts of kindness are superior to charity in three respects: Charity can be performed only with one’s money, while acts of kindness can be performed both with his person and with his money. Charity is given to the poor, while acts of kindness are performed both for the poor and for …”

paragraphs.text: Source: Tehillim 36:8 — “מה יקר חסדך אלהים ובני אדם בצל כנפיך יחסיון” — “How precious is Your faithful care, O God! Humankind shelters in the shadow of Your wings.”
